Thorough audit of original Webflow homepage source in /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.

Goal: Extract the EXACT spec the homepage should match — every section in render order, every CSS value, every image, every interaction. We are using this as the source of truth to fix our Next.js implementation.

Read in full:
- boldteq-v1-0.webflow/index.html (entire file)
- boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/normalize.css (just confirm what reset is applied)
- boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/webflow.css (framework basics — what utility classes does it define that we need)
- boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css — DO NOT read all 33k lines. Instead, after reading index.html, extract every unique class name used in the homepage and grep that file for each class to pull its rules + every responsive media-query variant (>=1280px, >=1440px, <=991px, <=767px, <=479px).

For EVERY top-level section in index.html (in render order), report:
1. The wrapping `<section>` class name(s)
2. Section purpose / human label
3. Full CSS spec for the section + every nested element used:
   - padding (top/right/bottom/left at every breakpoint)
   - margin
   - max-width / width
   - background (color, gradient, image)
   - display / grid-template-columns / flex / gap
   - border, border-radius, box-shadow
   - typography for text inside (font-size, font-weight, line-height, color, letter-spacing) at every breakpoint
4. Images: src path, alt text, width/height attributes, sizes
5. Buttons / CTAs: exact text, href, classes, styling
6. Animations / interactions referenced (data-w-id, scroll triggers, marquee, carousel)
7. Embedded scripts (GuideJar, Trustpilot widget, etc.)
8. Any inline style attributes

Also report:
- The `<head>` content: title, meta description, OG tags, JSON-LD, favicon, fonts loaded
- The exact navbar structure + classes
- The exact footer structure + classes (note we'll handle separately, but list)
- Any popup / modal markup in index.html
- Color tokens used (hex values that recur)
- Font-family declarations and weight loadings

Output a structured markdown report with one subsection per Webflow section in render order. This is the SPEC. Be exhaustive — we will diff our Next.js code against this. Read-only research, do not modify any files.
